NIST-114A
(REV. 3-90)		U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY
BIBLIOGRAPHIC DATA SHEET
1. PUBLICATION OR REPORT NUMBERNISTIR 4453
2. PERFORMING ORGANIZATION REPORT NUMBER
3. PUBLICATION DATENovember 1990
4. TITLE AND SUBTITLESRI International
Improving the Security of your UNIX System
5. AUTHOR(S)Edward Roback, NIST Coordinator
6. PERFORMING ORGANIZATION (IF JOINT OR OTHER THAN NIST, SEE INSTRUCTIONS)U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY
GAITHERSBURG, MD 20899
7. CONTRACT/GRANT NUMBER
8. TYPE OF REPORT AND PERIOD COVEREDNISTIR
9. SPONSORING ORGANIZATION NAME AND COMPLETE ADDRESS (STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIP)Reprinted by permission of SRI International, Information and Telecommunications Sciences and Technology Division, Menlo Park, CA 94025-3493
10. SUPPLEMENTARY NOTES
11. ABSTRACT (A 200-WORD OR LESS FACTUAL SUMMARY OF MOST SIGNIFICANT INFORMATION. IF DOCUMENT INCLUDES A SIGNIFICANT BIBLIOGRAPHY OR LITERATURE SURVEY, MENTION IT HERE.)SRI International's Improving the Security of Your UNIX System, written by Mr. David A. Curry, provides various suggestions for improving the security of those systems operating under the UNIX operating system. Following an introduction explaining the rising concern for security, specific techniques are discussed for protecting account security, network security, and file system security. User responsibilities are included. Mechanisms available to system operators to monitor security are then presented. Following that is an overview of the wealth of software that has been developed to improve UNIX systems, much of which is freely available. Sources for obtaining this software are included. Finally, the document includes reference sources, such as where to obtain the latest information about security problems, suggested reading, and a security checklist.
12. KEY WORDS (6 TO 12 ENTRIES; ALPHABETICAL ORDER; CAPITALIZE ONLY PROPER NAMES; AND SEPARATE KEY WORDS BY SEMICOLONS)ADP security; automated information system security; computer security; UNIX
13. AVAILABILITYX UNLIMITED
FOR OFFICIAL DISTRIBUTION. DO NOT RELEASE TO NATIONAL TECHNICAL INFORMATION SERVICE (NTIS).
ORDER FROM SUPERINTENDENT OF DOCUMENTS, U.S. GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE, WASHINGTON, DC 20402.
X ORDER FROM NATIONAL TECHNICAL INFORMATION SERVICE (NTIS), SPRINGFIELD, VA 22161.
14. NUMBER OF PRINTED PAGES56
15. PRICEA04

GAITHERSBURG, MD 20899

8. 報告書の種類および対象期間NISTIR
9. 後援組織の名称および正式な住所（番地、市、州、郵便番号）SRI International, Information and Telecommunications Sciences and Technology Division（Menlo Park, CA 94025-3493）の許可を得て再版
10. 補足事項
11. 要旨（最も重要な情報の事実に基づく 200 語以内の要約。文書に重要な文献目録または文献調査が含まれる場合は、ここに記載）SRI International の Improving the Security of Your UNIX System（David A. Curry 氏著）は、UNIX オペレーティングシステムで動作するシステムのセキュリティを向上させるための、さまざまな提案を示しています。セキュリティへの懸念の高まりを説明する序論に続き、アカウントのセキュリティ、ネットワークのセキュリティ、ファイルシステムのセキュリティを保護するための具体的な技法を論じています。利用者の責任も含まれています。続いて、システム運用者がセキュリティを監視するために利用できる仕組みを示しています。その後、UNIX システムを改善するために開発された豊富なソフトウェアを概観します。そのソフトウェアの多くは自由に入手できます。これらのソフトウェアの入手先も記載しています。最後に、セキュリティ上の問題に関する最新情報の入手先、推奨文献、セキュリティチェックリストなどの参考資料が含まれています。
12. キーワード（6〜12 項目、アルファベット順、固有名詞のみ大文字、キーワードはセミコロンで区切る）ADP security; automated information system security; computer security; UNIX
13. 入手可能性X 無制限
